mapper.select: select * from user_long_term_memory where patient_id_hash = #{patientIdHash} and active = 1 order by updated_at desc, id desc
mapper.insert: insert into user_long_term_memory( patient_id_hash, memory_type, memory_key, memory_value, severity, relation, evidence, source, confirmed, active ) values ( #{patientIdHash}, #{memoryType}, #{memoryKey}, #{memoryValue}, #{severity}, #{relation}, #{evidence}, #{source}, #{confirmed}, #{active} )
mapper.update: update user_long_term_memory set memory_type = #{memoryType}, memory_key = #{memoryKey}, memory_value = #{memoryValue}, severity = #{severity}, relation = #{relation}, evidence = #{evidence}, source = #{source}, confirmed = #{confirmed}, active = #{active} where id = #{id} and patient_id_hash = #{patientIdHash}
